Initial release of Add Background Music skill.

- Easily add AI-generated background music to your videos in seconds.
- Supports video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB; overlays and syncs music automatically.
- Simple instructions: upload a video and describe the music style you'd like.
- Videos are processed on cloud GPUs and returned ready-to-download, typically within 20–40 seconds.
- Includes session management, automatic token handling, and real-time progress updates.
- Provides workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
